pages.title: Goose Rescue: Screw Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Release a trapped bird in Goose Rescue: Screw Sort. Remove colored screws from the wooden pieces blocking its cage. Pairs of matching screws disappear in the collection area, so plan the removals to avoid filling that space before all the wood is cleared.

pages.title: Real War: Not Fake
pages.creator: DevDop
pages.description: Build a stronger fighting group in Real War: Not Fake. Move through useful gates, recruit more soldiers, and collect weapons along the battlefield. Bring the growing army against enemy waves and the large bosses waiting ahead.

pages.title: My Castle. Merge & Story
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Restore a medieval home in My Castle. Merge & Story. Combine identical items in pairs to produce what the renovation needs, then rebuild and decorate the old castle. Follow the young princess's story as she starts a life beyond royal expectations.

pages.title: Hook Pin Jam
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Clear a tangled formation in Hook Pin Jam. Tap hooks in an order that releases them from neighboring pieces and empties the board. Finish in fewer moves for better results, earn currency, and advance to more complicated layouts while managing the available lives.

pages.title: Racing Master 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Race along three-dimensional circuits in Racing Master 3D. Steer your chosen car through the course and compete against other drivers. Activate nitro when you need extra speed to pass a rival or gain ground.

pages.title: Mall Anomaly
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Spot unnatural changes in Mall Anomaly. Explore repeating shopping-center corridors and watch for details such as staring mannequins, floating furniture, or disappearing cats. Recognize the unusual scenes as you work through the mall's anomaly challenge.

pages.title: Onet Monster Book
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Pair creature-covered books in Onet Monster Book. Select two matching covers with a clear route between them to remove them. Clear every book from the layout and continue through more than a hundred levels of different monster arrangements.

pages.title: Moto Trials Rush
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Ride past dangerous mechanisms in Moto Trials Rush. Accelerate or slow down to avoid flying hammers and spikes, and rotate the bike to manage landings. Use the sideways controls to hop free if the motorcycle becomes stuck.

pages.title: Paws & Pals Diner
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Serve animal visitors in Paws & Pals Diner. Manage the restaurant's staff and food while keeping up with its furry customers. Unlock additional dishes and welcome different animals as you develop the diner.

pages.title: Radiant Rush
pages.creator: Qualia Interactive
pages.description: Collect every datacube in Radiant Rush. Steer a drifting car through the increasingly difficult courses while its speed is handled automatically. Concentrate on the turns and collectible routes to complete each level.

pages.title: Zombie Raft
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Keep a traveling platform alive in Zombie Raft. Protect the survivors from the approaching undead and push the vehicle onward when needed. Rescue stranded people you encounter while escaping the advancing zombie swarm.

pages.title: Blonde Chibi Fashion Show
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare two models in Blonde Chibi Fashion Show. Choose outfits and accessories for Blondie and Kenneth, adjusting the colors of their hair, clothes, and shoes. Complete separate looks for their appearance in the show.

pages.title: Jewels Blitz 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear jewel boards in Jewels Blitz 3. Swap neighboring gems to make rows or columns of at least three identical pieces. Larger combinations produce special jewels, and boosters can help meet the objective of a difficult level.

pages.title: Stickman Rugby Run And Kick
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Run to a rugby shooting chance in Stickman Rugby Run And Kick. Dodge or slide past obstacles, collect useful items, and score at least one kick each turn to advance. Account for wind when aiming, and use shields or magnets to help during the run.

pages.title: Pinnacle MotoX
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Compete around racing circuits in Pinnacle MotoX. Use the arrow keys to control the motorcycle and the space bar to brake. Judge the approach to each section as you work toward a faster race.

pages.title: Police Car Chase Simulator
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Drive through a desert pursuit in Police Car Chase Simulator. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys while handling the police chase. Use the left mouse button to launch rockets during the vehicle battle.

pages.title: Woodturning Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Shape pieces of timber in Woodturning Simulator. Use the cutting controls to remove material and follow the required wooden pattern. Refine the form with careful passes until the carved object matches the task.

pages.title: Sewage
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Find a way out of the drains in Sewage. Move through the underground routes and avoid guns and other obstacles. Collect gold along the journey to strengthen the character before continuing toward the exit.

pages.title: Idle Beauty Salon Tycoon
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Manage customer service in Idle Beauty Salon Tycoon. Keep the counter stocked, take payments, and respond to the visitors' requests. Move around the salon to handle its work and unlock additional business areas.

pages.title: Space Shooter
pages.creator: Immanitas Ent. GmbH
pages.description: Clear alien targets in Space Shooter. Click to fire and work quickly through the enemies on the screen. Aim to finish the shooting task in less time while building a better score.

pages.title: Toy Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match toy blocks in Toy Match 2. Combine at least three pieces of the same color to clear them and work toward each level's goal. Try daily missions, challenges, and treasure hunts alongside the game's large collection of puzzle boards.

pages.title: Emma Lip Surgery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help a patient recover in Emma Lip Surgery. Follow the game's treatment steps for Emma's infected lip, then take her shopping once the medical activities are finished. Choose clothing and accessories to complete the makeover.

pages.title: Besties Black Friday Collections
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare friends for a shopping outing in Besties Black Friday Collections. Browse the available fashion choices and put together looks for their trip. Give each friend an outfit suited to the group's Black Friday plans.

pages.title: 2 Player Dark Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race illuminated night courses in 2 Player Dark Racing. Drive against rivals alone or challenge a friend in split-screen mode. The two players use separate arrow-key and WASD controls to handle their vehicles through the tracks.

pages.title: Food Tiles Match 3
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Collect requested ingredients in Food Tiles Match 3. Swap neighboring tiles into horizontal or vertical groups of at least three matching pictures. Gather the level's required pieces to complete the board and continue.

pages.title: Maze Game 3D
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Find a key and escape in Maze Game 3D. Explore winding passages, collect the key, then locate the door leading onward. Complete fifteen mazes that become larger and harder as you progress.

pages.title: Funniest Catch
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Join two sailors in Funniest Catch. Hold and move the mouse to position the net, then release it to collect fish. Try to finish the catch with fewer clicks to earn more stars and achievements while seeking the legendary golden clownfish.

pages.title: Click-o-Trickz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Paint the playfield by clearing groups in Click-o-Trickz! Select clusters of matching blocks so the spaces beneath turn white. Cover the whole board to finish the puzzle and receive the witch's candy reward.

pages.title: Funny Math
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions in Funny Math. Read the elementary calculation and choose the correct result from the available answers. Continue through the questions to practice responding more accurately and quickly.

pages.title: Imposter Shooter Online
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Enter two-dimensional battles in Imposter Shooter Online. Choose among three characters with different abilities and three weapon types, then take on opponents online or offline. Gather shields and health pickups to extend your survival in the arena.

pages.title: Panda Fight
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Rescue the princess in Panda Fight. Drag and release to launch the panda through the action, defeat opposing pandas, and finish each level. Collect all the scattered stars if you want to complete the adventure fully.

pages.title: Ramp Crash
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: Take a vehicle over collision courses in Ramp Crash. Select a car and use the mouse to control the platform-driving challenge. Pass the stages and work toward completing the routes at greater speed.

pages.title: Pocket Tower
pages.creator: Overmobile
pages.description: Develop a busy skyscraper in Pocket Tower. Design floors for a business center and make choices that keep employees content and the operation growing. Trade and join the surrounding city while expanding the tower's commercial activity.

pages.title: BTS Pig Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose an animal drawing in BTS Pig Coloring Book. Apply your preferred shades to the pig illustration and fill the outlined details. Use mouse or touch controls to create a finished picture with your own colors.

pages.title: Picture Slide
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Restore scrambled photographs in Picture Slide. Move the tiles into order to complete images of animals, food, landscapes, cities, and objects. Try to solve each sliding arrangement in less time.

pages.title: 3 Link
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear groups of three in 3 Link. Connect three identical pictures of animals, food, or other subjects to remove them. Empty the whole board before the timer expires to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Christmas Lines
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Build rows of five in Christmas Lines. Move festive items into empty spaces to form horizontal or vertical lines of identical designs. A move without a match adds three new pieces, so preserve space as the board fills.

pages.title: Connect The Insects
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pair matching bug tiles in Connect The Insects. Use connecting routes with no more than two turns to remove identical pictures. Clear twenty-one levels before their timers expire, finishing quickly for additional points.

pages.title: Fast Penguin
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Jump for low-hanging stars in Fast Penguin. Click or tap the penguin to send it upward while avoiding black toothed platforms. Keep it away from the sharp sides of the field as you collect more stars.

pages.title: Princess Collective wedding
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Prepare several brides in Princess Collective wedding. Choose gowns and jewelry for their shared ceremony, then apply each character's makeup. Put the styling details together so every princess is ready for the group celebration.

pages.title: My Doll House: Design and Decoration
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Create an interior in My Doll House: Design and Decoration. Select room furnishings and arrange the available pieces around the doll's home. Try different combinations of furniture and decorations to complete the house's appearance.

pages.title: Valto Jumper
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Climb through a boy's dream in Valto Jumper. Guide Valto upward between platforms and collect the stars along the ascent. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to keep him progressing toward higher sections.

pages.title: Crazy Goat Hunter 2020
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Take aimed hunting shots in Crazy Goat Hunter 2020. Move around the hunting area and find an animal target before bringing the rifle into focus. Use the right mouse button to aim and the left button to fire.

pages.title: Bullet Man 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Line up difficult shots in Bullet Man 3D. Aim the gun past obstacles and eliminate the hostile characters in the scene. Check the route to each target before firing so barriers do not block the attempt.

pages.title: Memory Kids Halloween Game
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Pair seasonal pictures in Memory Kids Halloween Game. Tap two cards to reveal them and remember where their matching designs appear. Complete every pair to clear the level and continue through the remaining boards.

pages.title: Bowmastery zombies
pages.creator: Sayid Dzhukalaev
pages.description: Take on undead targets with a bow in Bowmastery zombies. Click or tap to fire arrows and use the scenes' explosive objects when they help reach enemies. Work through more than a hundred levels with ragdoll reactions and changing environments.

pages.title: Kill The Microbes
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Start a chain reaction in Kill The Microbes. Click a germ to burst it and send fragments outward toward nearby microbes. Choose the starting point carefully so the spreading impacts can clear the entire arrangement.

pages.title: Fast Racing Cars Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Color eight vehicle pictures in Fast Racing Cars Coloring. Choose from twenty-three shades and fill the image's outlined areas. Finish the car artwork and save a copy of the colored picture.

pages.title: Back to School Princess Preppy Style
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare students for their first day back in Back to School Princess Preppy Style. Browse the princesses' clothing and assemble school outfits from the available pieces. Follow the styling choices to finish a separate preppy look for each girl.

pages.title: Bingo Royal
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Mark called numbers in Bingo Royal. Choose from four difficulties and decide how many cards to play, then match the drawn numbers on each card. Watch for the required winning arrangement and call Bingo when it is complete.

pages.title: PenguinBattle.io
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Push rivals from a shrinking floe in PenguinBattle.io. Control a penguin on the iceberg and knock the others over its edge. Keep away from sections falling into the water and remain the final penguin on the ice to win.

pages.title: Euro Truck Sim Heavy Transport
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Carry freight over difficult roads in Euro Truck Sim Heavy Transport. Steer carefully around large vehicles and uneven route sections while keeping the load intact. Losing even one piece of cargo fails the level, so control the truck's movement through each hazard.

pages.title: Fantasy Christmas Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles into seasonal pictures in Fantasy Christmas Slide. Choose one of three illustrations and a puzzle mode before rearranging the scrambled sections. Match the scene's details to rebuild the full festive image.

pages.title: Wrestle Online
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Time jumps to overturn your rival in Wrestle Online. Use W or a tap to leap while trying to knock the other wrestler out. Play solo, share the device with a second player, or enter online matches and earn coins for skins.

pages.title: Dig Water
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Rescue burning plants in Dig Water. Use the mouse to excavate sand and open channels for the water above. Plan a route that carries the flow toward the plants instead of losing it in the wrong area.

pages.title: Food Truck Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Compare food vehicles in Food Truck Differences. Find seven changes in each pair of pictures before the two-minute limit ends. Work through ten illustrated scenes by checking the trucks and their surrounding details.

pages.title: Halloween Magic Tiles
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Keep up with falling notes in Halloween Magic Tiles. Click or tap each orange tile as it appears in the piano-style challenge. Follow the sequence carefully to continue through the seasonal music game.

pages.title: Kids Puzzle Adventures
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Put together illustrated scenes in Kids Puzzle Adventures. Drag the scattered jigsaw pieces into the positions that restore the picture. Compare their shapes and colors to find the place of each remaining piece.

pages.title: Frenzy Chicken Farming
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Run a growing homestead in Frenzy Chicken Farming. Care for chickens and cows, collect products such as eggs and milk, and develop factories that turn those goods into new items. Manage the different production steps as the farm expands.

pages.title: Color Blocks
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Place fixed shapes in Color Blocks. Fit the three offered pieces onto the grid to complete and remove full rows or columns. The pieces cannot rotate, and the next set stays hidden until the current three have been used.

pages.title: Crazy Pong
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Keep a ball inside a circular arena in Crazy Pong. Move the paddle left or right to meet its return and prevent an escape. Continue successful rebounds to build a higher score.

pages.title: Logo Memory Food Edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pair brands with their names in Logo Memory Food Edition. Reveal cards and remember the food-company logos and labels they contain. Match each logo to the correct brand name to clear the board.

pages.title: EG Flags Memory
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Learn country designs in EG Flags Memory. Turn over cards and pair each national flag with its country's name. Choose easy, normal, or hard difficulty, with larger card arrangements in the tougher settings.

pages.title: Pixel Art 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Fill numbered models in Pixel Art 3D. Choose a three-dimensional picture, select a color, and hold over blocks carrying the corresponding number. Complete models from categories such as animals, vehicles, and food by working through their palettes.

pages.title: Gun Masters
pages.creator: f-igri.ru
pages.description: Make each attempt count in Gun Masters. Take an accurate shot before the enemy can return fire, since a miss gives the opponent its chance. Earn money and shop for new weapons, including rarer equipment choices.

pages.title: Skater Girl
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Run a course on a board in Skater Girl 3D. Guide the skater along the route and gather coins during the attempt. Spend the collected money on additional costumes for the character.

pages.title: Fill Line
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Connect a grid with one continuous route in Fill Line. Plan how the line can pass through the block arrangement and complete the puzzle. Look ahead before choosing a direction so the remaining spaces can still be reached.

pages.title: Princess Soup Kitchen
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Experiment with unusual recipes in Princess Soup Kitchen. Add fantasy ingredients such as frog legs, bat wings, or unicorn horns to the pot. Try different mixtures and watch the princess react to the resulting soup.

pages.title: Gift Craft
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Match holiday pieces to create a present in Gift Craft. Keep space available on the board as the combinations develop toward the finished gift. Choose beginner or advanced play, a two-minute timed challenge, or a mode limited to fifty turns.

pages.title: Burger Stack
pages.creator: Creacle
pages.description: Build an oversized meal in Burger Stack. Add ingredients onto the growing burger and try to make it taller. Keep placing the layers carefully as you work toward a larger stack.

pages.title: Princess as Los Vegas Showgirls
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dress three performers in Princess as Los Vegas Showgirls. Choose stage makeup and feathered outfits for Elsa, Ariel, and Rapunzel. Put together each character's look before they take part in the show.

pages.title: 7x7 Ultimate
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear colored lines in 7x7 Ultimate. Move tiles around the seven-by-seven board to form matching rows and remove them. Build combinations while preserving space, and save undo or move-anywhere boosters for positions that need help.

pages.title: Scuba Turtle
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Guide a diving reptile in Scuba Turtle. Travel underwater and keep the small turtle's journey going for as long as possible. Work toward a greater distance in the endless course.

pages.title: Funny Soccer Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Choose a side and play Funny Soccer Game. Move left and right with the arrow keys, use Z to head the ball, and press X to kick. Send shots into the opposing net while defending your own goal.

pages.title: Mini Putt Gem Forest
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Play through wooded putting courses in Mini Putt Gem Forest. Aim for the hole while avoiding hazards and collecting gems along the way. Adjust each shot to the ball's new position and try to finish with fewer strokes.

pages.title: Princess Hotdog Eating Contest
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Support a royal contestant in Princess Hotdog Eating Contest. Choose Elsa, Anna, Jasmine, or Ariel and press the requested keys to help her eat quickly before time ends. Challenge a friend when you want another player in the competition.

pages.title: Snail Bob 1 html5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide a determined snail to his next home in Snail Bob 1 html5. Click mechanisms and objects in each scene to open the way through its puzzles. Help Bob pass the hazards and continue toward his new abode.

pages.title: Silly Ways To Die: Party
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Keep the performers safe in Silly Ways To Die: Party. Follow the rhythm while using mouse or keyboard inputs to handle the stage's dangers. Help the dancing monsters stay in time and avoid getting zapped.
